tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text token reads on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Header strip and other page chrome.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised objects: stat tiles, chart cards, tables, records, tooltips.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Notice band under the header, highlighted rows.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and lists, chart gridlines.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of cards, tiles and regions; section rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Table header rule and tooltip border. Decorative strength, not a control border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and toggles: 3:1 or more on paper and card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, surface, card and band. Also the fill of a primary button.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dek, callout body, table cells.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, labels, axis ticks, metadata.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the focus ring, the note callout and chart series 1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Link colour on hover.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the note callout.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Title text inside a note callout.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Good or complete: check glyph, label and callout border. Never a chart series.

tokens.name: good-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the good callout.

tokens.name: good-text
tokens.usage: Title text inside a good callout.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and caps: triangle glyph, label and callout border. Never a chart series.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the warning callout.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Title text inside a warning callout.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Failures and refusals: octagon glyph, label and callout border. Never a chart series.

tokens.name: critical-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the critical callout.

tokens.name: critical-text
tokens.usage: Title text inside a critical callout.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (blue).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (copper).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (rose).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (moss).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (violet).

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: Everything past series 5, folded into Other; also de-emphasised comparison lines.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The report headline (h1). Scale down to 28px on phones.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: The dek under the headline, in ink-2.

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Running report text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Quoted words from a person or a source.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The report or publisher name in the header strip.

styles.name: callout-title
styles.usage: The one-line title of a callout.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Interface text: captions, sub-lines, table cells, notices.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Stat tile labels, rail terms, status labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Table headers and rail headings, set uppercase.

styles.name: record
styles.usage: Record blocks: logs, outputs, quoted system text, with white-space pre-line.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Ids, dates, versions, costs, counts inline, deltas and chart legends.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The line above the headline, set uppercase.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Chart axis ticks and tooltip dates.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a legend or tooltip row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stat tiles and between callouts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The page gutter on wide screens; header padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of the page body.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between report sections and between rail and main column.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Width of the report-details rail beside the main column.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the main reading column.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page grid.

tokens.name: radius-record
tokens.usage: Record blocks: square, like a printed entry.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Callouts, tooltips, buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, chart cards and table frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for something that floats over content, such as a sticky jump button. Cards and tooltips use borders.
